verdict.rationale: Cloudflare docs explicitly advertise durable Workflows with cron/queue integration and per-compute (not wall-time) billing for long agent workflows (cloudflare-docs-9, cloudflare-docs-15), suggesting built-in durability without manual queue/retry wiring. However, community feedback specifically flags CPU-time limits (30s free, 15min paid) as inadequate for long-running agent workloads, undermining the 'durable, long-running' claim (cloudflare-comm-9).
